# Permanent Scenario tab checks

Mount `scripts/Game` temporarily under the Workbench profile's `scripts/Game/ScenarioTabChecks`, reload and start an empty-briefing Arland preview. Invoke `GC_TestScenarioTab(false)` on `GC_MissionTemplate` / `GC_LobbyManager`; then invoke with true to dispatch the production tab-click handler. Repeat to close. `GC_TestParameterVisibility(true/false)` isolates late Parameters visibility delivery through the real parameter-change handler without modifying the authority catalog. Stop Play, remove only the verified junction and reload afterward.

2026-11-14, Workbench 1.9.0.37: empty briefing list had Scenario visible, order=1, last=1, initially unselected. Click selected it and opened title `01 SCENARIO`; second click closed its document while the row stayed visible. Actual MCP screenshot showed the Scenario row and all seven populated environment rows. Operations `5912efaaf9f548fca9683deb8db52450`, `36f9dd1b8af34a128b35946d9652ffec`, `6c6d2bbc96d4445aa3767db714602f8b`.

Independent review found parameter-change events must refresh the whole index. After correction and successful compilation `fcbfbe0d476e481da3efcf2195bd1180`, selected Scenario stayed last and open while its order and title changed 1 -> 2 -> 1 as optional Parameters visibility changed. Operations `20b868bb82f54bbd8d58201862c6c631`, `061a37ebcc024fb391c0620acaacd1f0`, `47d6728033a74ff29d5ee05c30876b84`. Review approved. Mixed authored catalogs, remote peers and additional viewport sizes were not separately exercised; authored scenario-tag deduplication and selection logic were source-reviewed.
